question: For item lines belonging to 2025 orders, join to the food dimension and classify each line as Veg, Non-Veg, or Unknown (null or unmatched food ID). Report for each group: (1) item-line count, (2) total ordered units, (3) share of total ordered units computed as group ordered units divided by the sum of ordered units across all three groups times 100. State the total ordered units used as the denominator.

action.query:
WITH categories AS (
  SELECT column1::VARCHAR AS food_group
  FROM VALUES ('Veg'), ('Non-Veg'), ('Unknown')
), classified AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN d.FOOD_ID IS NULL OR d.VEG_OR_NON_VEG IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(d.VEG_OR_NON_VEG)) = 'VEG' THEN 'Veg'
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(d.VEG_OR_NON_VEG)) = 'NON-VEG' THEN 'Non-Veg'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS food_group,
    i.QUANTITY
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER_ITEM i
  JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
    ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_FOOD d
    ON i.FOOD_ID = d.FOOD_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), grouped AS (
  SELECT
    food_group,
    COUNT(*) AS item_line_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(QUANTITY), 0) AS ordered_units
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY food_group
), results AS (
  SELECT
    c.food_group,
    COALESCE(g.item_line_count, 0) AS item_line_count,
    COALESCE(g.ordered_units, 0) AS ordered_units
  FROM categories c
  LEFT JOIN grouped g ON c.food_group = g.food_group
)
SELECT
  food_group,
  item_line_count,
  ordered_units,
  SUM(ordered_units) OVER () AS total_ordered_units_denominator,
  100.0 * ordered_units / NULLIF(SUM(ordered_units) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total_ordered_units_pct
FROM results
ORDER BY CASE food_group WHEN 'Veg' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-Veg' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

action.answer:
For item lines on orders with recorded ORDER_DATE in 2025, the total ordered-units denominator across all three groups is 12,230,877 units.

| Group | Item-line count | Ordered units | Share of total ordered units |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Veg | 7,277,939 | 8,877,759 units | 72.584811% |
| Non-Veg | 2,749,222 | 3,353,105 units | 27.415082% |
| Unknown (null or unmatched food ID) | 12 | 13 units | 0.000106% |

Shares are group ordered units divided by 12,230,877, multiplied by 100; displayed percentages may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.
